scripts.name: Chat Log
scripts.author: ReSA
scripts.summary: Saves every chat line to a file per day and shows the chat in a searchable window.

scripts.name: Script Manager
scripts.author: ReSA
scripts.summary: Reload, unload and start your scripts in game, restart scripts that stopped on an error, read the AL Loader log and run Lua in a shell. Swipe left on the radar, or press ` on a keyboard, to open it.

scripts.name: Command Buttons
scripts.author: ReSA
scripts.summary: Buttons on the game screen that run your commands with one tap. Drag them anywhere, set their size and opacity.

scripts.name: Quick Commands
scripts.author: ReSA
scripts.summary: Your own buttons for the commands and chat lines you use all the time.

scripts.name: Info HUD
scripts.author: ReSA
scripts.summary: FPS, ping, your ID, position and the time in a corner of the screen.

scripts.name: InfoWindow
scripts.author: Cyabo, ReSA
scripts.summary: FPS, ping, your ID and position as outlined text on the screen. Pick the lines, the text size and the place with /adjinfow, or drag the text while its menu is open.

scripts.name: FreeCam
scripts.author: 4trays.Team, ReSA
scripts.summary: Fly the camera with on-screen buttons while your character stays put: move it, turn and tilt it, and set its speed.
